products.body:
Tommy Langaker and Espen Mathiesen have ransacked the WAR CHEST for this highly anticipated passing series

  • Dismantle modern guards with efficiency and intelligence
  • Employ perfect passing combinations and efficient movements to keep guard players guessing
  • Discover fresh details and new innovations for traditional passes you already know


Tommy Langaker and Espen Mathiesen have ransacked the WAR CHEST for this highly anticipated passing series

Dismantle modern guards with efficiency and intelligence

Check Out The Trailer!

What Will You Learn?

The guard pass must be a top priority for any BJJ player! Bring the pressure with this unique Viking style approach to SMASH THROUGH MODERN GUARDS. The distinctive northern twist on old favorites will have you revisiting the Over Under Pass and Knee Slice with a fresh set of eyes, as you discover new and EXCITING DETAILS ON THESE AND OTHER TRADITIONAL PASSES.. .
The Old Norse word VIKING means to go on an expedition and Tommy Langaker and Espen Mathiesen have quite the journey in store for you! With INCREDIBLY WELL PAIRED PASSING COMBINATIONS, you’ll immediately be treated to several “light bulb” moments. Langaker and Mathiesen have assembled a detailed blueprint, weaving together all of the most traditional effective passes you already know, with STELLAR NEW SCHOOL DETAILS AND CONNECTIONS!

So What's On This Series?

With 4 volumes of EXPERTLY CRAFTED INSTRUCTIONAL MATERIAL you'll be exposed to incredible new details on how to approach modern guard configurations. You'll learn how to use the reverse De La Riva against your opponoents, applying some slick passing combos to LEAVE THE GUARD PASSER’S LOWER HALF IN THE REARVIEW MIRROR. You’ll find the leg drag, the over under pass, the stack, all showcased here with loads of problem solving detail and innovations! With simple, clear, and concise instruction, you'll love the format of the four volumes as Langaker and Mathiesen connect each passing style to the next and help you realize some of the most common pitfalls. They’ll assist you in tightening up your top game, providing you with an increased understanding of how these different passes link together to form the ultimate passing procedures!

Hip Switch To Back Take

products.title: Viking Guards by Tommy Langaker and Espen Mathiesen
products.body:
Europe’s TOP black belts are here to give you the guard of a VIKING!

  • Tommy Langaker and Espen Mathiesen have been tearing up the international competition scene with superior guard work and incredible back takes.
  • Bring back the Berimbolo with two of the best ‘bolo players in the game.
  • Enter the Matrix with Tommy’s advanced sweeps and back takes.
  • Give your Gi game an upgrade by using unique grips and entries that leave your opponent defenseless!


Europe’s TOP black belts are here to give you the guard of a VIKING!

Tommy Langaker and Espen Mathiesen have been tearing up the international competition scene with superior guard work and incredible back takes.

Check Out The Trailer!

What Will You Learn?

Tommy Langaker and Espen Mathiesen are easily two of Europe's most accomplished black belts. Both athletes have found success at the highest level of competition including superfights at Polaris, and even IBJJF! Just when you thought that you had to be in Brazil or the U.S. to become a top tier Jiu-Jitsu fighter, Tommy and Espen flip the script with their Viking Guards instructional.

Viking Guards is a 4-part instructional dedicated to helping you develop an aggressive guard that focuses on attacks! You won’t find any footage out there of these two Norwegian powerhouses stalling. Any match with one of these guys is sure to be packed with scrambles, back takes, and submission!

So what makes their approach work at the highest level? Both Espen and Tommy bring a unique approach to Jiu-Jitsu that blends classic grips with new-school tactics. The collar & sleeve combination of grips is as old as Jiu-Jitsu, but they find a way to insert unusual methods that will give your game an overhaul.

Take the red pill, and ENTER THE MATRIX! One of the most talked about techniques in Jiu-Jitsu these days is Tommy’s Matrix back take. Finally, Tommy breaks down an essential method he uses to systematically break his opponent down and secure the back. Learn the ins and outs of one of the most efficient and effective techniques in Jiu-Jitsu in Viking Guards!

Not all Berimbolos are created equal, and very few are as technical as Tommy and Espen’s Berimbolo! BUT before you Berimbolo everyone you meet, learn to master the De La Riva guard. To master the Berimbolo you must first become a DLR devastator! Learn to attack from all angles and constantly off-balance your opponent by using the De La Riva guard.

What’s even more impressive is how these two tie everything together. Once you learn the individual techniques you will be able to chain them together to create an unstoppable flow of attacks that will leave your opponent swept and submitted!

DLR With Underhook To X-Guard Sweep

So, What's On This Series?

Part 1:

  •  Intro
  • Collar & Sleeve Concepts 
  • Langaker Omoplata to Sweep

Part 2:

Part 4:

  • DLR with underhook to x guard sweep 
  • X guard to matrix back take
